description:

North Lanarkshire
16.48 per hour
Hours of work Monday to Friday 9am - 5pm

We are currently recruiting for an experienced Receptionist & Administrator to join our client within the care sector on a 6-month temporary contract.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Hybrid (1 day per week on-site, max 2 days when fully integrated) Free parking

The Payroll Administrator will provide vital business-as-usual (BAU) support to ensure the smooth operation of high-volume payrolls during a major system transition. The organization is currently preparing to migrate from iTrend to Oracle in April/May 2027. You will be responsible for processing multiple payroll runs and managing complex pension schemes.

Key Deliverables
Act as a key payroll focal point to support the team through a critical system migration from iTrent to Oracle.
Deliver consistent, high-volume BAU payroll processing for approximately 5,000 staff across 3 monthly payrolls.
Administer and coordinate complex pension schemes, specifically managing Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS) and Teachers' Pensions.
Resolve complex pay and pension queries in an efficient and timely manner to support employee wellbeing and engagement.
Manage the payroll workflow end-to-end, including processing new starters, leavers, structural changes, and contract variations.
Receive, verify, and input employee absence, sickness, and statutory payment records.
Process holiday requests, overtime claims, and manual payroll adjustments for payment processing.
Investigate and correct timesheet and payment errors, escalating system anomalies as required.
Maintain accurate and detailed logs of all personnel queries and payroll adjustments to ensure robust audit trails during the transition period.

Key Requirements / Qualifications
Education: Relevant payroll qualification (CIPP or equivalent) or demonstrated capability via extensive hands-on experience.
IT Skills: Solid IT skills across the MS Office Suite, including strong Excel and data analysis capabilities.
Experience: Previous experience managing high-volume payrolls within a complex, multi-payroll environment. Experience handling roughly 5,000 records across multiple monthly cycles is highly advantageous.
System Knowledge: Prior experience utilizing iTrent or Oracle payroll software is highly desirable, though not strictly non-negotiable.
Pension Knowledge: Demonstrable experience working with public sector pension schemes, specifically LGPS and Teachers' Pensions, is highly preferred.
Industry Knowledge: Previous experience working within a College, University, Local Council, or broader Public Sector environment is highly desirable.
Communication: Clear and confident communicator at all levels, capable of explaining complex payroll and pension queries face-to-face, via email, and over the telephone.

52570 AD

INDPAYN

The Portfolio Group are acting on behalf of our client in recruiting for this position.

title: Procurement Administrator
description:
Procurement Administrator
Renfrewshire Permanent Circa 26,000
Are you an organised administrator with strong IT skills and a good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel? Looking for an opportunity to develop your career within a growing organisation?
Pertemps are working on behalf of a successful and expanding business in the Renfrewshire area who are looking to recruit a Procurement Administrator to join their busy team on a permanent basis.
This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with previous administration experience who is keen to build their knowledge of procurement, purchasing and supply chain processes.
The Role:

- Providing day-to-day administrative support to the procurement function.
- Raising and monitoring purchase orders.
- Liaising with suppliers regarding orders, deliveries and invoice queries.
- Maintaining accurate records and updating internal systems.
- Monitoring outstanding orders and following up on delivery dates.
- Updating spreadsheets and preparing reports using Microsoft Excel.
- Supporting stock replenishment and maintaining accurate stock records.
- Building effective working relationships with suppliers and internal departments.

About You:

- Confident using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.

- Able to manage workloads, prioritise tasks and work as part of a team.

What's on Offer?
- Permanent, full-time opportunity.
- Salary circa 26,000.
- Free on-site parking.
- Opportunity to join a growing organisation.
- Excellent scope for career development and progression.
- Support and training to develop your procurement knowledge.

Interested?
If you have solid administration experience and are looking for your next opportunity, we'd love to hear from you.
Interviews are expected to take place quickly, so don't miss out!
Pertemps acts as both an employment business and an employment agency

title: Repairs Administrator
description:
Currently recruiting for a Repairs Administrator to join a well-established housing association in Glasgow on an initial 6-month temporary contract.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an organised, customer-focused individual to join a busy Property Services team, supporting the delivery of reactive repairs, maintenance and void property services.

We're keen to hear from candidates with experience in repairs administration, maintenance coordination, property services or customer service, particularly those who enjoy working in a busy environment and managing multiple priorities.

The Role

Working as part of the Property Services team, you'll be responsible for providing administrative and customer service support across reactive repairs and void maintenance.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Handling incoming repairs enquiries by telephone, email and in person.
- Logging repairs and raising works orders on the housing management system.
- Coordinating appointments and inspections for Maintenance Officers.
- Liaising with contractors, tenants and utility companies to ensure repairs progress efficiently.
- Monitoring void property repairs and supporting the turnaround of empty properties.
- Updating maintenance records, compliance information and property databases.
- Assisting with contractor invoices and general administration.
- Logging customer complaints and supporting customer satisfaction processes.
- Providing administrative support to the wider Property Services team.

About You

We're looking for someone who has:
- Previous experience in administration, repairs coordination, property maintenance or a similar customer-focused role.
- Excellent communication and organisational skills.
- The ability to manage a busy workload and prioritise effectively.
- Strong IT skills and experience using CRM or database systems.
- A proactive, helpful approach and excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to work confidently with customers, contractors and colleagues.

Previous social housing experience would be advantageous, particularly experience using QL or other housing management systems. However, candidates with strong transferable skills from property maintenance, facilities management or customer service environments are also encouraged to apply.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of 27,068 per annum
- 35-hour working week
- Initial 6-month temporary contract
- Opportunity to gain valuable experience within the social housing sector
- Supportive and friendly working environment

Interested?

If you're an experienced administrator looking for your next opportunity, we'd love to hear from you!

Apply today with your CV, or contact Laura at RG Setsquare for a confidential chat.

Applications close Monday 9 November 2026, with interviews expected Monday 16 November 2026.

RG Setsquare is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

title: Receptionist / Front of house
description:
An opportunity has arisen for a Receptionist / Front of house to join a legal practice, providing professional legal services and maintaining an efficient and welcoming office environment.

As a Receptionist, you will take primary responsibility for reception and front-of-house activities, welcoming visitors, handling telephone enquiries and ensuring the smooth running of the reception area.

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Customer Service Advisor

Red Recruitment is recruiting a Customer Service Advisor to join our client's Customer Financial Assistance and Recoveries team in Glasgow.

You will support customers with car finance enquiries, including ending agreements early and managing the next steps when a vehicle has been written off. Combining telephone support with administration and casework, you will guide customers through sensitive situations with empathy, clarity and care.

This is a permanent opportunity, with the option to work hybrid after six months.

Benefits and Package for a Customer Service Advisor:
- Salary: 13.30 per hour
- Hours: Shifts worked on a rolling rota within Monday - Friday, 8am - 6pm, and Saturday, 9am - 5pm
- Contract Type: Permanent
- Location: Glasgow, office-based initially with the option to work hybrid after six months

Key Responsibilities of a Customer Service Advisor:
- Handling incoming calls from customers looking to end their car finance agreement early
- Explaining eligibility, the process and any outstanding payments clearly and accurately
- Supporting customers whose vehicles have been written off, liaising with insurance companies and providing settlement figures
- Recognising vulnerable customers and those experiencing financial difficulties, ensuring they receive appropriate support
- Processing paperwork, updating customer records and maintaining accurate case notes
- Following up on enquiries and arranging vehicle collections with partner suppliers
- Identifying complaints and following the appropriate procedures to ensure fair customer outcomes

Skills and Experience of a Customer Service Advisor:
- Excellent customer service and communication skills, with confidence handling sensitive or challenging conversations
- An empathetic approach and good judgement when supporting customers in difficult circumstances
- The ability to explain complex information in a clear and straightforward way
- Strong attention to detail and accurate administration skills
- Confidence navigating multiple systems and managing follow-up tasks
- A minimum of six months' financial services experience is advantageous but not essential

If you have the relevant skills and are interested in this position, please apply now!

title: Call Centre Agent
description:
Start date: 25.01.2027

Shift Pattern: Full Time (37.5 hours)

Please note that this position is a full-time role only, and part-time hours are not available.

Sales Advisors

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our Glasgow team's full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Glasgow contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, discounted parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Recruitment Administrator - Immediate Start
description:
Recruitment Administrator - 6 month contract
Glasgow City Centre - Hybrid working available after training
Monday to Friday, 35 hours per week
Pay Rate 17.47ph

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organised and proactive Recruitment Administrator to support a busy, high-volume recruitment team. This role is responsible for coordinating and administering the full end-to-end recruitment process, ensuring vacancies are filled efficiently while delivering an excellent experience for candidates, hiring managers, and stakeholders.

Working in a fast-paced and often high-pressure environment, the successful candidate will manage multiple recruitment campaigns simultaneously, maintain accurate records, and ensure compliance with company policies and recruitment procedures.

Key Responsibilities
Recruitment Coordination
- Manage the end-to-end recruitment administration process across multiple vacancies
- Coordinate job postings across internal and external recruitment platforms
- Screen and process applications in line with agreed recruitment criteria
- Schedule and coordinate interviews & assessment centres
- Liaise with candidates throughout the recruitment lifecycle, providing timely updates and maintaining a positive candidate experience
- Support recruiters and hiring managers with recruitment activities and vacancy management

Compliance and Onboarding
- Ensure all recruitment activities comply with company policies, employment legislation, and data protection requirements.
- Conduct pre-employment checks, including right-to-work verification, reference requests, and background screening.
- Prepare offer documentation and employment contracts where applicable.
- Coordinate onboarding activities to ensure a smooth transition from candidate to employee.

Key Skills and Experience
Essential
- Previous experience in a recruitment, HR administration, or talent acquisition support role.
- Experience supporting high-volume recruitment campaigns across multiple vacancies.
- Strong administrative and organisational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
- Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage competing priorities.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Outlook, Excel, Word, and Teams.
- Experience using Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) or recruitment management systems.
- Strong customer service focus with the ability to build positive relationships at all levels.

Key Competencies
- Planning and organising
- Attention to detail
- Managing competing priorities
- Customer and candidate focus
- Stakeholder engagement
- Problem solving
- Teamwork and collaboration
- Resilience and adaptability
- Communication and influencing skills
- Confidentiality and professionalism

This role is ideal for an individual who thrives in a fast-paced recruitment environment, enjoys managing high volumes of activity, and takes pride in delivering an efficient and professional recruitment service.

Search is an equal opportunities recruiter and we welcome applications from all suitably skilled or qualified applicants, regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/beliefs, sexual orientation or age

title: Business Support Assistant
description:
Business Support Assistant

Location: Glasgow
Hours: Full Time, Monday to Friday
Salary: 30,000 - 35,000 depending on experience

Benefits
- Company pension with enhanced employer contributions based on length of service
- Life assurance (3x annual salary following successful completion of probation)
- Private medical insurance following successful completion of probation
- 20 days annual leave, plus 3 additional days between Christmas and New Year when the office is closed, and 10 public holidays
- Long service awards
- Recruitment referral bonus
- Eligibility for discretionary annual bonus
- Hybrid working by agreement

About the Role

We are looking for an organised and proactive Business Support Assistant to join our friendly consultancy team in Glasgow.

This is a varied administrative role supporting surveyors, consultants, and directors with day-to-day business activities. The successful candidate will be responsible for producing professional documents, managing reports and correspondence, coordinating office administration, and helping the team deliver an excellent service to clients.

A key part of the role will involve copy typing, audio typing, proofreading, and formatting reports to a high standard. Experience producing professional documents from dictated notes, recorded meetings, or draft reports would be highly beneficial.

The role would suit someone with previous experience in an administration, team support, office support, PA, secretary, or business support position who enjoys working in a fast-paced professional environment.

Previous experience within a property, construction, surveying, engineering, architectural, or consultancy business would be advantageous but is not essential.

Key Responsibilities
Administration & Document Production
- Audio typing and copy typing of reports, letters, meeting notes, and professional correspondence.
- Preparing, formatting, proofreading, and issuing client-facing reports and documents.
